digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler / Jira Data Center bridge
propositions: Bidirectional reconciliation (inbound and outbound mutations) must be proven live against a realistic store copy, not an empty instance, with hard isolation preventing any write to production Jira.

The test suite must comprehensively exercise all 28 mutation pairs (14 inbound, 14 outbound) with per-mutation oracles asserted individually, capturing operator-attested evidence that data moves in both directions.
Data Center has distinct defects from Cloud in status transitions, identity minting, link handling, and parent manipulation that a complete mutation matrix reveals.

The test isolation must be enforced at multiple layers: no git remote on the working repo, separate store-repo with no origin, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and scrubbed bindings preventing any remote write intent.

Pagination must be exercised and measured explicitly: observe the server's effective page size, seed 2×observed+1 issues to force multiple pages, and assert full recovery rather than silent truncation.
